_comment: Points of interest for the TRPL campus viewer. Each POI: id (unique), title, image (path, optional), description, cta {label,url} (optional, opens in a new tab), position 'x y z' and normal 'x y z' on the 3D model. Use the coordinate picker (add ?edit to the URL, then right-click the model) to grab position/normal for new POIs. Sample copy below is placeholder — replace with final text and images.

pois.title: The Library
pois.description: Set into the Badlands rather than perched on top of them, the Library's living green roof and warm rammed-earth walls fold quietly into the landscape that shaped Theodore Roosevelt.

pois.title: Overlook Loops
pois.description: Two spiraling boardwalks lift you out over the draw for a slow, deliberate look at the badlands country.

pois.title: West Trail
pois.description: The western path traces the rim, connecting the campus to the wider landscape on foot.
